summary: Initializes a mutex-pair/list object: clears two DWORD pointer slots (offsets 0x0, 0x4), two byte state flags (offsets 0x8, 0x18), and sets two INFINITE timeout DWORDs (-1 at offsets 0x10, 0x20). Creates two anonymous inheritable mutexes via CreateMutexA (0x0059E1AC), storing each handle at offset 0xC and 0x1C and setting the corresponding created flag (offsets 0x14, 0x24) to 1 only when the handle is non-null. Returns this.

local_names.v2: CreateMutexA result stored as mutex 1 handle (this+0xC)
local_names.v3: CreateMutexA result stored as mutex 2 handle (this+0x1C)
local_names.MutexAttributes: 12-byte SECURITY_ATTRIBUTES with inherit flag set and null security descriptor

operations.description: Set the byte flag at this+0x8 to 0, clearing list-1 state.
Set the DWORD at this+0xC to 0 before storing the mutex-1 handle.
Set the byte at this+0x14 to 0, clearing the mutex-1 created flag.
Set the DWORD at this+0x10 to -1, initializing the mutex-1 timeout to INFINITE.
Call CreateMutexA (0x0059E1AC) with a 12-byte SECURITY_ATTRIBUTES (null security descriptor, bInheritHandle=1), initial owner 0 and null name, creating anonymous mutex 1; result captured in v2.
Store the mutex-1 handle v2 into the DWORD at this+0xC.
If mutex-1 handle v2 is non-null, set the created flag byte at this+0x14 to 1.
Set the byte flag at this+0x18 to 0, clearing list-2 state.
Set the DWORD at this+0x1C to 0 before storing the mutex-2 handle.
Set the byte at this+0x24 to 0, clearing the mutex-2 created flag.
Set the DWORD at this+0x20 to -1, initializing the mutex-2 timeout to INFINITE.
Call CreateMutexA (0x0059E1AC) again with the same attributes, creating anonymous mutex 2; result captured in v3.
Store the mutex-2 handle v3 into the DWORD at this+0x1C.
If mutex-2 handle v3 is non-null, set the created flag byte at this+0x24 to 1.
Set the DWORD at this+0x0 to 0, clearing the list head pointer.
Set the DWORD at this+0x4 to 0, clearing the second list pointer.
